editorial:
Imagine waking up to a mountain of cash, but there is a huge catch. That is exactly what happens to Daffy Duck in this wild ride. After a rich guy leaves him a fortune, Daffy finds out he cannot just spend it on fancy hats and gold pools. He has to use the money to help people, or the dead millionaire's ghost will take it all back. To cheat the system, Daffy starts a fake ghost-hunting business and drags along Porky Pig, Sylvester, and Bugs Bunny. It feels like a chaotic road trip where everyone is annoyed with Daffy, and the vibe is just pure, silly energy from start to finish.

You will love how the movie mixes old-school cartoon clips with new scenes to tell a full story. The comedy hits hard because Daffy is as greedy and loud as ever, which makes his failure even funnier. While some of the transitions between the old and new animation feel a bit jumpy, the jokes keep things moving fast. If you are looking for a nostalgic trip, you should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. Or, if you are a real fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the end, Daffy's plan to get rid of the ghost backfires completely. He tries to use his ghost-busting gear to banish the millionaire for good so he can keep the money for himself. However, the ghost outsmarts him, and Daffy ends up losing the fortune because he broke the rules of the will. He finishes the movie right back where he started, proving that greed always catches up to him in the funniest way possible.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Looney Tunes and slapstick comedy.
